about_the_game:
OROBOROS is an arcade-action game where, as you fight to complete your cycle, enemies and adventure are dragged onto you; packed with explosions, bursting with excitement, and loaded with challenge. Eating your own tail has never been this hard.

"The loop has been broken. Life as we know it is no more. Darkness veiled everything.

Oroboros, noble guards of the loop, scattered through the universe...

But maybe there is still hope to be whole again..."

Now it’s time to take control of your fate. Pick an Oroboro and dive into this unique and mysterious adventure.

You'll encounter many foes and friends on the road. Opportunities to hone your skills, discover hidden collectibles and slay mighty bosses await you!

Oroboros is a myth-inspired arcade challenge where every click changes destiny. Guide the legendary serpent as it draws infinite circles, flip directions with precise timing, and outsmart enemies to survive.

Grow bigger with every completed loop, collect powerful buffs, and dodge relentless enemies. But you have to focus on one thing! Eat your own tail to escape the endless cycle and complete each level.

One tap is all it takes to control destiny but mastering the rhythm is another story. Every click flips your direction, turning a single mistake into chaos. Quick reflexes and sharp timing are the keys to conquering infinity.

One-Tap Control → Tap to flip Oroboros’ direction and guide it until it bites its own tail.

Use your Oroboros Powers → Some attack, some stop time, some become a rock!..

Challenges will catch you when you least expect it, putting you to the test. The risks are great, and so are the rewards!

MEET THE CHARACTERS!

Mimesis → The Joker! Mimics all the other Oroboros’ powers.

Atlas → Transforms into stone, granting temporary invincibility.

Yuzu → Stops time and locks down enemies.

Waldorf → Fires rockets that send enemies straight to the “Soul Eater."

Ultegra → Emits powerful resonance waves to clear danger.

Flab → Your bat companion, protecting you in the darkest caves.

LOTS TO PICK UP!

Mushroom → Collect mushrooms to gain superpowers and become invincible for a short period of time.

Coins → Basic currency used to upgrade your Oroboro.

Rocket → Fill the special power bar of Oroboro.

Shield → Shields oroboro from enemies for a short period of time.

SlowTime → Slows time for a short period of time.

Can you master the eternal cycle… or will chaos consume you?

Wishlist Oroboros now and prepare to face infinity.
